subject: pathology
title: Multinodular Goitre, Papillary Cancer Orphan Annie Nuclei, Follicular and Medullary Carcinomas

steps.tx: Multinodular goitre enlarges thyroid through cycles of hyperplasia and involution under iodine deficiency or goitrogens, nodules autonomously functioning toward toxic multinodular disease in older patients. That nodular enlargement is **multinodular goitre**. Individual nodules in the same gland behave independently, some hyperfunctioning while neighbours involute, and dominant or enlarging nodules still deserve cytology despite the benign background.
steps.say: Nodular, asymmetric, longstanding goitre in an older patient is multinodular disease; scan its function and airways.

steps.tx: Papillary thyroid carcinoma spreads lymphatically to neck nodes in young patients with excellent survival, psammoma bodies, and grooved coffee bean nuclei whose empty chromatin earns Orphan Annie fame. Those nuclei are **Orphan Annie eye nuclei of papillary thyroid carcinoma**. Intranuclear cytoplasmic pseudoinclusions complete the cytological signature, and BRAF V600E is the commonest driver mutation in adult papillary tumours submitted to molecular panels.
steps.say: Empty grooved nuclei like Orphan Annie eyes name papillary thyroid cancer before immunostains speak.

steps.tx: Follicular carcinoma cannot be diagnosed cytologically because malignancy means capsular or vascular invasion seen only histologically, follicular adenoma its benign twin. That invasion rule is **follicular thyroid carcinoma, invasion-defined malignancy**. Widely invasive tumours spread haematogenously to lung and bone, while minimally invasive capsular only lesions often need little beyond lobectomy and surveillance.
steps.say: Follicular cytology can never promise benign; invasion on histology alone separates adenoma from carcinoma.

steps.tx: Medullary thyroid carcinoma secretes calcitonin from parafollicular C cells, amyloid stromal deposits Congo red positive, RET mutations in familial MEN2 forms earning prophylactic thyroidectomy timing. That C cell cancer is **medullary thyroid carcinoma**. About a quarter of cases are hereditary, so germline RET testing follows every new diagnosis, and phaeochromocytoma must be excluded before thyroid surgery in carriers.
steps.say: Calcitonin plus amyloid stroma names medullary carcinoma; RET status decides family thyroidectomy clocks.

nodes.label: Family prophylactic surgery timed by codon

steps.tx: BRAF and RAS molecular panels refine indeterminate thyroid cytology toward surgery or surveillance while papillary microcarcinomas increasingly earn active surveillance in selected patients. That molecular triage is **molecular testing in indeterminate thyroid nodules**. Bethesda III and IV nodules benefit most, because a benign genomic call there can safely spare a diagnostic lobectomy that older pathways imposed.
steps.say: Molecular panels rescue indeterminate cytology from diagnostic surgery in many thyroid nodules.

vis.caption: Diagnostic pathway for thyroid nodules integrating TSH, ultrasound and fine needle aspiration.

steps.tx: Thyroid nodule workup sequences TSH, ultrasound risk pattern, and FNAC by size thresholds, suppressed TSH diverting to scintigraphy for hot nodules rarely malignant. That sequence is **thyroid nodule TSH ultrasound FNAC pathway**. Taller than wide shape, irregular margins and microcalcifications each raise suspicion, and purely cystic or spongiform nodules can usually be watched without any needle pass.
steps.say: TSH first, ultrasound pattern second, needle by size and suspicion: thyroid nodules in three moves.

steps.tx: Postoperative thyroglobulin monitors differentiated thyroid cancer recurrence after total thyroidectomy and ablation, rising levels hunting residual disease by imaging. That surveillance protein is **thyroglobulin after thyroid cancer treatment**. Antithyroglobulin antibodies interfere with the assay in about a quarter of patients, so antibody trend itself becomes a surrogate marker when the main measurement turns unreliable.
steps.say: After total thyroidectomy, thyroglobulin becomes the tumour marker it could never be with gland intact.

steps.tx: Retrosternal goitre compresses trachea and veins behind sternum, Pemberton sign flushing face on arm raising, CT mapping surgery before airway emergencies. That thoracic inlet squeeze is **retrosternal goitre with Pemberton sign**. Pemberton manoeuvre raises both arms until facial flushing, venous engorgement or breathlessness appears, and most such glands still deliver through a cervical incision alone.
steps.say: Arms up, face flushed: Pemberton sign warns the goitre is strangling the thoracic inlet.
